prerequisites: Passing all assessments for the courses included in the curriculum and earning the corresponding credits

learning_outcomes.text: The student is eligible to take the final examination, for which the specified credits are awarded.
The final examination consists of the preparation and defense of a thesis that is primarily application-oriented.

assessment_methods.method: Preparation and defense of a thesis

assessment_rules: The final exam is evaluated by assigning a grade that contributes to the final degree grade on a scale of 110. The evaluation takes into account the content of the paper, its presentation, and any other elements deemed relevant. The minimum final grade is 66 out of 110. The thesis may receive a final exam grade (VOTO_PF) not exceeding 3/110, or 4/110 if the degree is earned within three academic years, to be added to the base grade (VOTO_BASE) to determine the final degree grade: VOTO_LAUREA = VOTO_PF + VOTO_BASE. The distinction "Lode" may be awarded only if the base grade plus final exam grade equals or exceeds 110/110, the curriculum includes at least one graded exam with honors, the supervisor(s) submits a reasoned request for honors, and the committee is unanimously in favor. The base grade may be increased by a score equal to NCFU/12 for a total not exceeding 1 point for educational activities carried out abroad.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (Mechanical Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
